title: Modeler loss and Binary-DXF route audit
mode: primary-source peer and release research with bounded local scratch probe; plan update only
scope: Recheck open-source DWG/DXF modeler carrier loss reports and exact release/PR status
Separate raw carrier inspection, B-rep semantics, AcDs association, and native consumer capability
Screen current Binary-DXF parser routes and refresh the S2.2.5b readiness path
Record a self-unblock path without increasing routine validation cost

method.kind: Primary project documentation/source, issue and release pages, plus existing local scratch artifacts

sources.use: Current open report for 0.14.8593 where R2013+ modeler entity shells survive while AcDs-associated SAB payloads are absent from conversion output.
Current source contains an AcDs section-reading path; its presence alone does not prove the named release's conversion/API exposes exact owner/key/payload closure.
Open report of silent 3DSOLID/REGION omission by a named ACadSharp DXF writer version, including solid-only blocks.
Still-open, undeployed linked proposal; visible commit summary targets DWG ModelerGeometry serialization and is not proof of the DXF-writer issue being fixed.
Latest listed release is v3.8.0; its release notes do not list the still-open #1240 branch.
ezdxf exposes raw SAT/SAB browsing/export, not a solid B-rep semantic result.
ACIS carrier creation is documented as an external-library responsibility.
GDAL 3.12 adds Binary-DXF input; AC1027+ extensible modeler mode exposes raw ASM bytes plus a transform but does not create OGR solids.
FreeCAD's two stock DXF importers have distinct entity sets and do not currently read embedded ACIS/SAT solids.
Current document claims an AcisSabParser route and edge reconstruction.

Current architecture document says the older ProGPU.Dxf ACIS readers/shader were inspected and rejected as incomplete. Source/tests were not independently traced; mark the contradictory documentation unverified.
LibreCAD 3 documents a read-only DWG product policy gated by native write evidence.

localScratch.disposition: NOT_QUALIFIED; no claim that the generated file, payload delta, or cut policy is valid

method.peerExecutableRuns: LibreDWG dxfwrite 0.14 was run to create a scratch Binary DXF and then failed to parse the produced full document.
method.limitations: Peer documentation and current main branches are mutable and project-specific. Issue reports identify failure shapes, not normative format rules or libdxfrw defects. The local source file is an existing user-owned non-repository input with unverified producer provenance; the generated output was temporary. No independent parser accepted the full candidate document, so no positive Binary-DXF or SAT claim is made.

findings.existingGateRefined: S2.2.5b Binary-DXF/SAT positive admission and next-ready self-unblock

peerRouteAssessment.LibreDWG: Open #1411 is release-scoped; current source path presence is not conversion qualification.
peerRouteAssessment.ACadSharp: #1195 remains open; #1240 is open/undeployed and its visible change targets DWG serialization.
peerRouteAssessment.ezdxf: Binary DXF carrier/parser and raw ACIS utility; not B-rep semantics; ACIS authoring requires another library.
peerRouteAssessment.GDAL: Binary-DXF reader candidate from 3.12; modern 3D extensible path is raw ASM+transform, not solid semantics; not installed locally.
peerRouteAssessment.FreeCAD: Stock DXF import does not consume ACIS/SAT bodies.
peerRouteAssessment.ProGPU: Conflicting DXF.md and architecture claims; source/test route unresolved and non-admitted.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep the existing generated ASCII/Binary boundary matrix as fast local preservation coverage; do not alter production cuts from the failed peer candidate.

At most once at the existing composed checkpoint, use an already-installed independent DXF reader on scratch-only locally authored AC1018/AC1021 Binary-DXF input; require full-document acceptance through terminal EOF and no section error.
Compare modeler handle/type, ordered group-1/group-3 chunks, decoded length/hash, following-record sentinel, owning block, and complete source/output disposition.
Do not equate entity survival with payload preservation or use the original ASCII carrier as an exact oracle after a peer conversion unless byte changes are independently explained.

If no available independent reader accepts the whole document and exposes the legacy SAT carrier, record NOT_QUALIFIED and continue the next dependency-ready local ledger item without installing a dependency, downloading a drawing, or running a full suite.
Keep AC1027+ SAB/AcDs association, independent analytic geometry, and FreeCAD/native consumer evidence in their existing composed gates.
